snippet.title: Rise of Tyrants AMA with Founder & Game Director Knighter
snippet.description:
This is the largest expansion in RavenQuest's history - and the date is set. Mark it. Clear your schedule. The Tyrants are coming March 23rd.

00:00 Introduction 
02:11 Tyrant Teasers and Mad Scientist Design
05:11 Tyrant Difficulty and Party Coordination
09:30 Rise of Tyrants Showcase Video
12:12 Rise of Tyrants Release Date
13:50 Group Size and Raid Philosophy
19:42 Sigil Tiers and Scaling Difficulty
20:52 Strategic Gameplay vs. Tank and Spank
22:58 Relics and Character Progression
25:21 PVE Leaderboards and Competitive Tracking
28:54 Entry Costs and Silver Economy
29:34 Raid Bosses vs World Bosses 
46:30 Level Caps and Effective Level Discussion
53:52 Economy Revamp and Trade Packs
1:11:00 Treasures Below RavenPacks Update
1:20:23 Warforging Shards and Skill Reworks
1:12:30 Tyrant Entry Clarification
1:36:00 Marketplace Quality of Life Upgrades
1:39:06 Multi-chain Strategy and IMX
1:55:50 Archetype Transfer Community Poll
2:10:58 Blackjack and Fortunes Frontier
2:27:11 Final Remarks 

Full Dev Blog available here: https://ravenquest.io/en/news/view/tyrant-system
